newsitem.title: USA: U.S.B. Holding Co Inc Q1 net rises.
newsitem.headline: U.S.B. Holding Co Inc Q1 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: The company said net income for first quarter 1996 includes gains of $0.4 million on securities transactions, current first quarter results do not include those gains.

The company also said it completed a trust capital securities offering in first quarter 1997 that raised $20 million of capital. The 9.58 percent capital securities, due February 1, 2027 qualify as Tier I or core capital, it said.
The offering will be used for general corporate purposes and to retire $3,250,000 in existing preferred stock, U.S.B. said.
